walkthroughs.body_html:
Stoichiometry — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Stoichiometry brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Stoichiometry.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

What does a mole of a substance represent?
options: A mole is a unit of mass equal to the relative molecular mass in grams of any substance.
Avogadro's number (6.02 x 10^23) of particles of that substance.
A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
Kc is always dimensionless.

mcqs.q: What are the units of Kc for a reaction?
options: Kc is always dimensionless.
A hydrogen bond is a bond formed when hydrogen molecules fuse together.
Kc always has units of mol dm^-3.
They depend on Δn (the difference between moles of gaseous/aqueous products and reactants) — Kc can be dimensionless or have units like mol dm^-3.
Kc is always dimensionless.
A hydrogen bond is a covalent bond involving hydrogen.
A strong dipole-dipole interaction between an H atom bonded to N/O/F and a lone pair on another electronegative atom.
A hydrogen bond is a bond formed when hydrogen molecules fuse together.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Mass number”?
options: Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.

Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atom”?
options: Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
